thread:
jamal_cs: FYI — EduLex support ticket: after the 2024-04-02 canary, their FAQ assistant started returning refusals for benign product-facts. They provided examples, and it's reproducible.

liya_support: Can you paste the exact prompt and the assistant reply?

jamal_cs: Prompt: "When was ProductX v2 released and what are its main performance improvements?"\nAssistant reply: "Sorry, I can't help with that." — no policy text, just a short refusal. Happening ~30% of requests per their sample (was ~1% before).

liya_support: Thanks. Customer says this started after the slim-quant/v2 kernel rollout on Dedicated pool A. Any canary flags still active?

ops-bot: alert: safety_refusal_rate spike detected for customer=edulex model=redwood-v1-slim-quant in region=us-west-2 — 2024-04-03T16:22:11Z

max_platform: I'm looking at the rollout notes — we shipped a safety-sensitivity tweak + new attn-kernel on that canary. I'll check rollout shard IDs and model config hashes. Jamal, can you ask EduLex for a small repro set (5 examples) and an API trace (request headers + model id + routing id)?

jamal_cs: Sent repro set and a sample API trace. They used model id "redwood-v1-slim-quant:20240402" and see the same behavior on both Hosted and their Dedicated node behind our routing.

sara_research: For triage: run a batch eval of the repro set on the pre-rollout model snapshot and the canary snapshot, capture logits and safety scores. If logits for harmless tokens drop below threshold, that's our signal.

max_platform: Quick check: latency and error rates unchanged. It looks like the safety classifier threshold was accidentally bumped in the canary config (sensitivity 0.6 -> 0.75). I'm reverting the flag on the shard and will redeploy a corrected canary. ETA ~30m.

liya_support: I'll update EduLex with repro steps and the rollback plan. Will collect post-rollback logs to confirm. Thanks.

jamal_cs: Customer appreciated quick response. Keeping thread open until post-rollback verification.

ops-bot: deploy_rollback started by max_platform for rollout redwood-v1-slim-quant:20240402 — 2024-04-03T16:55:02Z
